scope: ACM SIGCOMM main conference, 2022-2026, title-level screen of the official listings

rule.ai_infra_networking: The evaluated subject is the network, fabric, transport, scheduling or state movement that serves a machine-learning training or inference workload: collective communication, accelerator interconnects, KV-cache movement, expert parallelism, production AI-cluster fabrics.
rule.ai_infra_adjacent: Tooling or interconnect work that an AI fabric depends on but whose evaluated workload is not machine learning.
rule.ml_serving_other_scale: Machine-learning inference serving at a scale other than an AI datacenter, such as edge servers or video analytics.
rule.satellite_substrate: A satellite or orbital substrate, or its network service.
rule.aerial_adjacency: A stratospheric or low-altitude aerial substrate.
rule.excluded_on_purpose: Machine learning used as a technique to operate a network (learned congestion control, learned traffic engineering, LLM-assisted operations) is not counted as AI-infra networking.

caveat: Denominators are the title rows listed on the official page fetched on the screen date. The 2022 and 2023 denominators come from program pages and the 2024-2026 denominators from accepted-paper pages, so the five denominators are not identically constructed. A title-level screen can misclassify a paper whose title hides its workload; the satellite column was additionally checked against each paper's abstract or session placement.

zero_year_check: The 2023 and 2024 satellite counts of zero were confirmed against a second independent official page for each year. Both secondary pages were fetched and searched on the screen date for satellite, LEO, orbit, Starlink, constellation, non-terrestrial and direct-to-cell; every one of those searches returned zero matches in both pages.
method: Each listed page was fetched with curl on the screen date, tags were stripped, and titles were extracted structurally: the per-paper heading element for 2022 and 2023, the paper-title paragraph for 2024, the title span for 2025 and the title cell for 2026. Each extracted title was then classified by hand against the rule above. Title strings quoted elsewhere in the report were additionally confirmed by searching the fetched page for the exact string.
